def design(trace, taus):
    tp = np.asarray(trace['past_timestamps'])
    u = np.asarray(trace['strain_u'])
    t = np.asarray(trace['timestamps'])
    hp = np.asarray(trace['past_strain_history'])
    taus = np.asarray(taus)
    x = np.r_[hp, u]
    time = np.r_[tp, t]
    m = np.empty((len(x), 2))
    m[0] = x[0]
    for (k, a) in enumerate(np.exp(-np.diff(time)[:, None] / taus), 1):
        m[k] = a * m[k - 1] + (1 - a) * x[k]
    return np.column_stack((np.ones(len(t)), u, m[len(tp):]))
